tools.name: create_expense_ledger
tools.description: Use this when a group wants to track shared costs for a trip, a shared house or an event and split them fairly: it publishes a shared web page where everyone adds what they paid, and returns a public link to share and a private organizer link. Optional starting expenses and payments can be included.

tools.name: show_expense_ledger_results
tools.description: Use this when the organizer asks for the balances, who owes whom, or the settle-up payments of a shared expense ledger made with create_expense_ledger. Takes the private organizer link and returns each person's paid, share and balance, the settle-up list and recent expenses. Does not change the ledg

tools.name: add_ledger_expenses
tools.description: Use this when the organizer tells you about expenses or payments to add to an existing shared ledger. Takes the private organizer link and up to 40 expenses or payments; returns the new balances. Names must match the members. Does not edit or delete expenses (use update_expense_ledger to delete).

tools.name: update_expense_ledger
tools.description: Use this when the organizer wants to add members, delete expenses by their number (#3), rename the ledger, change the note, or close or reopen the page. Takes the private organizer link. Deleting removes the expense from all balances. Does not remove members who are already in expenses.
